meta.title: MH Dental Anesthesia — In‑Office Anesthesia for Pediatric & Adult Patients
meta.description: MH Dental Anesthesia provides expert mobile dental anesthesia in San Francisco, CA. Safe, personalized care by a dual board‑certified Dentist Anesthesiologist.

hero.badge: Mobile dental anesthesia for pediatric & adult patients
hero.headline: Safe, compassionate anesthesia — delivered in your dental office.
hero.subheadline: MH Dental Anesthesia provides advanced in‑office anesthesia care across the San Francisco Bay Area, including for patients with complex medical needs. Every plan is tailored and personally managed by Dr. Hurd.

pain_points.label: The Challenge
pain_points.title: Dental anesthesia must be safe, personal, and seamless
pain_points.subtitle: Families and providers need confidence that every case is expertly planned, monitored, and supported — without added complexity for the dental team.

items.title: Anxious Patients & Families
items.body: Fear, sensory challenges, and prior bad experiences make dental care difficult without specialized anesthesia support.

items.title: Complex Medical Histories
items.body: Patients with medical complexity need individualized anesthetic plans, not one‑size‑fits‑all protocols.

items.title: Office Coordination Burden
items.body: Dental teams need an anesthesia partner who handles prep, monitoring, and recovery — without disrupting clinic flow.

items.title: Safety & Trust Expectations
items.body: Families want clear communication, real‑time reassurance, and emergency‑ready preparedness at every step.

messages.text: Can you handle pediatric cases with sensory needs?

messages.html: Yes. We routinely care for pediatric patients with sensory sensitivities and complex medical histories. Each plan is tailored and reviewed with families in advance.

messages.text: Do you provide deep sedation for adults?

messages.html: ✅ Yes — we offer moderate and deep sedation for adult procedures, with comprehensive monitoring throughout.

solutions.label: How MH Helps
solutions.title: A higher standard of in‑office anesthesia care

items.title: Patient‑Centered Anesthetic Plans
items.body: Every plan is designed around the individual — not a template. We listen first, explain clearly, and partner with families in decision‑making.

items.title: Inclusive & Accessible Care
items.body: We welcome patients of all abilities, ages, and medical complexity — removing barriers whenever possible.

items.title: Compassion Meets Clinical Excellence
items.body: Advanced training, dual board certification, and decades of emergency medicine experience guide every procedure.

items.title: Safety Before, During, After
items.body: Comprehensive monitoring, full emergency preparedness, and continuous vigilance ensure safety at every step.
